properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 2 at 7:13AM EDT until September 2 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Buffalo NY
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Lake Ontario from Wilson to Hamlin Beach.

At 712 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing waterspouts
was located 20 nm northwest of Sunset Beach, or 26 nm northeast of
Niagara River, moving southeast at 35 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts in excess of 50 knots, and small
hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Boats could suffer significant structural
damage in high winds. Small craft could capsize in suddenly
higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
Sunset Beach.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 2 at 5:46AM CDT until September 2 at 10:45AM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
FFWLCH

The National Weather Service in Lake Charles has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Hardin County in southeastern Texas...
South Central Tyler County in southeastern Texas...

* Until 1045 AM CDT.

* At 546 AM CDT, emergency management reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 10 and 21
inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 5
inches in 1 hour. Flash flooding is already occurring.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for Kountze, Village Mills, Honey Island.
This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lumberton, Kountze, Wildwood, Saratoga, Warren, Honey Island,
Village Mills and Batson.

Down stream locations such as Village Creek State Park and low areas
between Silsbee and Lumberton.
properties.instruction:
Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and
life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are
fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.description:
SVRCLE

The National Weather Service in Cleveland has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Crawford County in northwestern Pennsylvania...

* Until 830 AM EDT.

* At 729 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Union City,
or 22 miles southeast of Erie, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to vehicles is possible. Expect damage to
trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Riceville, Canadohta Lake, Lincolnville, and Spartansburg.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Large hail, damaging wind, and continuous cloud to ground lightning
are occurring with this storm. Move indoors immediately. Lightning is
one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder,
you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.
